blocks.html: Structural steel H-piles and structural steel sheet piling shall conform to the material requirements in ASTM A 6. Steel pipe piles shall conform to the material requirements in ASTM A 252. Welded built-up steel piles shall be fabricated from plates that conform to the material requirements in ASTM A 36, ASTM A 283, ASTM A 572, ASTM A 588 or ASTM A 690.
